- Verify the identity and address of the walk‑in customer for every sale of third‑party products worth ₹50,000 or more, as required under clause (5) of paragraph 21 of the Directions.  
- Obtain and verify the customer’s PAN (or equivalent e‑document) and, where applicable, Form 60 for those without PAN.  
- Maintain transaction details of the sale and related records in accordance with paragraph 50 of Chapter VII.  
- Ensure AML software capable of capturing, generating and analysing alerts for filing CTR/STR for such transactions is available.  
- Conduct the transaction only by debit to the customer’s account or against cheques, and incorporate the purchaser’s name on the face of the instrument.
